down: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-ready 2D dark fantasy RPG transparent character animation sprite sheet. Reference images are character-design and action references only; reproduce this original armored soldier's identity, not their checkerboard background. Character: Windwood Ironwall Heavy Infantry, a stocky fully enclosed dark gunmetal plate-armored soldier with bronze trim, narrow visor helmet, forest-green scarf and tattered long dark green cape, huge tall rectangular kite/tower shield bearing a golden tree emblem and small white wolf emblem, ONE short steel spiked mace held in the right hand, shield strapped to left arm. No sword, no spear, no second mace, no extra limbs. Same equipment in EVERY cell. Hand-painted detailed sprite art readable at small scale, consistent elevated RPG camera and proportions. Layout is EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and THREE EQUAL ROWS, 12 separated whole-body poses, all the SAME facing direction. Transparent RGBA background, no checker pattern, no grid lines, no titles, no numbers, no floor or scenery. Each pose centered within its cell with generous 12% transparent margin around the full cape, shield, weapon and feet, including raised mace; nothing touches or crosses cell edges. Equal character body size in all cells. Row 1 four distinct WALK cycle frames: left step, feet passing, right step, feet passing opposite; heavy deliberate marching with clearly changing feet and subtle cape sway. Row 2 four distinct ATTACK frames: prepare mace behind shoulder, raise mace, slam/swing mace forward downward, recover mace back near waist. Shield remains on the left arm throughout, one mace stays attached to right hand. Row 3 columns 1 and 2: two distinct CAST/battle-rally poses lifting mace and shield, subtle blue magical light close to armor. Row 3 columns 3 and 4: two distinct HIT/recoil poses, shield braced then recovering, small near-shield gold sparks only. Real pose differences, not twelve identical copies. Full boots and bottom tips of shield visible. No text, watermark or labels. Landscape sprite sheet approximately1536x1024. ALL 12 POSES FACE TOWARD VIEWER (south/down), slightly three-quarter FRONT view, visor face and breastplate visible, shield on viewer right, mace on viewer left. NEVER show back.
